newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oils steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oils steady to firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil was steady to firmer on Monday but industry events in London stifled much of the market, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded between $98 and $100 fob ARA and bunker demand was assessed at around 10,000 tonnes.
High sulphur cargoes were assessed slightly stronger following a deal on Friday at $97.50 cif U.K.
A trader was heard to have been bidding at $98 cif NWE for another piece but no more business was heard to have been done.
Low sulphur fuel oil was steady to firmer.
A trader was heard bidding at $99 fob NWE for an ENEL-quality cargo loading in late February or early March.
At least two cargoes are thought to be available in NWE on the spot market for this time period.
